requiredCitations: Each original paper identified by the record PMID and DOI
rights.programmaticAccess: Metadata acquired through the official API and standardized SWCs through documented direct file URLs with an identifying User-Agent; no JSP scraping.

purpose: Provide one checksum-gated source-local main-scene morphology record for each already-admitted frozen census member. This derived index contains metadata and asset receipts only; it does not duplicate or alter any geometry payload.

scientificBoundary.membership: The 142 rows are records returned by the pinned NeuroMorpho query; they are not independent animals, a population-frequency denominator, or evidence of biological completeness.
scientificBoundary.labels: Cell-class labels are preserved as repository wording. Query membership and labels do not establish a paper-verified subtype or a relationship to another molecular/profile record.
scientificBoundary.geometry: Each displayed shape is the exact checksum-verified standardized SWC in its own unregistered source-local frame. The two source-labelled 2D records remain planar source inputs, not reconstructed 3D cells.
